quotes.text: Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our HaluCheck models, trained with curriculum DPO approach and high quality negative samples, significantly improves model performance across various metrics, achieving improvements of upto 24% on difficult benchmarks like MedHallu and HaluEval.
For the purpose of this work we choose MedHallu and HaluEval for the DPO alignment, as they have high quality hallucinated samples.

Benchmarks like Hades (Liu et al., 2022) and HaluEval (Li et al., 2023) offer strong hallucination-detection protocols, and MedHallu (Pandit et al., 2025) provides carefully crafted adversarial answers that are ideal for our alignment approach.

We conduct extensive evaluations on the MedHallu (Pandit et al., 2025) and HaluEval (Li et al., 2023) benchmarks and zero-shot evaluation on DROP, CovidQA, and PubMedQA, demonstrating that HaluCheck substantially outperforms existing baselines, including the widely adopted Llama-3.2 (1B and 3B) models.
